213399: Lilia is the real form of Lily's anti-demon weapon. She pretends to be Lily's sister towards Lily's friends.
315430: The first friend Akutsu made after transferring. At first glance, he is a herbivorous man who seems harmless to humans and animals, but he is actually quite a strategist, and his dark side occasionally peeks through.
315432: Kensaku's childhood friend (self-proclaimed girlfriend). She has a burning rivalry with Lily, who she views as her romantic rival.
315433: Akutsu's boss in the demon world. She sends Akutsu to the human world with high expectations. She seems like a good boss who is passionate about her work, but she is a bit out of touch and tends to make misguided plans. She is an unconscious cosplay enthusiast.
322663: The teacher of Akutsu's class. He is concerned about his thinning hair. Although he has a scary and blunt personality, he is a nice guy who guides the students with his strange masculinity and middle-aged sadness.
